body: claimed: Codex (skull) · 2026-11-20T11:05Z · branch mkinney:issue/2908-batch-lanes · plan: add `cargo xtask gate batch --lane N/M` (a deterministic split, each test target in exactly one lane) and `cargo xtask gate verdict` (one verdict from the lane records). partial work on issue/2908-batch-lanes · PR #2942 · pinned by `each_batch_step_runs_in_exactly_one_lane`, `a_lane_builds_each_crate_that_it_tests_before_the_tests`, `a_bad_lane_is_refused_by_name`, `a_missing_a_double_a_void_or_a_short_lane_is_red` (14 tests in `lane_split_tests`, `verdict_tests`) · merges when reviewed

The PR has `Refs #2908`, not `Fixes #2908`. This issue stays open after the merge.

Done in PR #2942:
- `cargo xtask gate batch --lane N/M`: a deterministic split, each test step and clippy in exactly one lane. Three lanes get 325, 324 and 324 of the 973 steps.
- Each lane run writes `lane-result.tsv` into its `gate-logs/batch-<stamp>/`.
- `cargo xtask gate-verdict <dir>...`: one verdict with each lane, its runner, its time, its result and the red steps. A lane with no record makes the verdict red.
- The `gate` skill describes the lanes.

Not done, and why:
- `.github/workflows/post-merge.yml` does not use the lanes. My brief does not permit a change in `.github/`. PR #2606 (`needs-maintainer`) changes the `report` job of the same file.
- The `runners` skill text, the macOS runner `m3`, and the treatment of a push during a run. These go with the workflow.

Proposal for the workflow (not applied, not tested):
1. A job `yield` runs `post-merge-skip.sh` one time and gives the output `skipped`.
2. A job `lane` has `needs: yield`, `strategy: { fail-fast: false, matrix: { lane: [1, 2, 3] } }` and `runs-on: [self-hosted, camcraft-post-merge]`. It runs `cargo xtask gate batch --lane ${{ matrix.lane }}/3`. It uploads `gate-logs/` with `if: always()` as `gate-logs-lane-${{ matrix.lane }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}`.
3. A job `report` has `needs: lane` and an `if` that starts with `always()` (the cause of #1611). It downloads the artifacts with `pattern: gate-logs-lane-*`. It runs `cargo xtask gate-verdict <download dir>`. The verdict text is the body for the rolling issue, and the exit code is the status.
4. The triggers and the concurrency group do not change. With one runner the three lane jobs queue. With three runners they run at the same time.
5. Each runner must have its own checkout directory. Two runner services on one machine must not share a `target/`.

Open decisions for the maintainer: the lane count (a fixed 3, or the runner count), and #2606 (merge it first, or let the new `report` job replace it).

in-review removed: PR #2942 merged 14:31Z today as partial work (Refs). The "Done means" needs two lanes at once on one push; what merged is the lane split and one lane. The rest is free for the next claim.
